personal_info.title: M. Tech student in Artificial Intelligence at IIT Gandhinagar

about_section.message: Hi, I'm Shivam Kumar, a M. Tech student in Artificial Intelligence at IIT Gandhinagar with a passion for building intelligent, data-driven systems that solve real-world problems. I recently led my team to win the National AI Hackathon 2025 at IIT Gandhinagar, where I developed an AI-powered EV Battery Safety System integrating Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning for predictive battery health monitoring.

projects.name:
AI-Powered EV Battery Safety System
(Winner – National Level AI Hackathon 2025, IIT Gandhinagar)
projects.description:
• Built a hybrid ML–RL safety intelligence framework combining ensemble learning (RF + MLP) with a rule-governed agent, achieving 95+% detection accuracy on 5.3M NASA samples with <10 ms latency.
• Designed a self-learning Q-learning safety agent with 75% safety accuracy and 6× state-space coverage gain through critical-scenario sampling and adaptive fine-tuning cycles.
• Deployed an interactive Streamlit dashboard featuring a Battery Health Index (BHI) and climate-adaptive safety thresholds across India's five diverse climate zones and four seasons for predictive alerts and anomaly visualization.

projects.name:
Smart Product Analytics Platform for Sellers
(Full Stack + AI)
projects.description:
• Architected and deployed a full-stack AI analytics platform for Amazon product sentiment analysis, processing 25K+ reviews with ASIN-based insights and cross-feature trends.
• Developed a RAG-powered conversational AI using LoRA fine-tuned TinyLlama (1.1B) with semantic search and fallback to pre-trained models under 8 GB AWS constraints.
• Deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with Docker, ALB load balancing, and automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions and Terraform for scalable, reproducible infrastructure.

projects.name:
Bangalore Urban Flood Extent Prediction
(AI Product Engineer Intern, AIResQ ClimSols, Research Park IIT Gandhinagar)
projects.description:
• Developed a scalable geospatial data pipeline ingesting multi-source data (Satellite imagery, DEM, Rainfall) and generated ground-truth flood data for Bangalore using Sentinel-1 imagery.
• Built a dataset automation tool in Google Earth Engine and trained a multi-input U-Net CNN with mid-layer rainfall fusion, achieving F1-score 0.84 (>87% pixel accuracy) on flooded pixels.
• Deployed a Flask REST API for real-time model predictions, enabling scalable inferencing and integration.

projects.name:
Large Language Model Fine-Tuning with Limited Resources
(LLM Fine-Tuning Project)
projects.description:
• Fine-tuned a 1.2B parameters Llama model on Wikipedia dataset with an end-to-end Hugging Face pipeline for enhanced language generation.
• Achieved training feasibility on a single, limited GPU (Colab T4) by leveraging LoRA on key attention components (0.13% trainable parameters) and 4-bit Quantization.
• Achieved a 6.16% token prediction accuracy improvement and significantly enhanced generated output relevance/fluency through comprehensive evaluation.
